INTR_EC3 (1627 - 1627)
EC-3: Many women have times when they are not having intercourse
at all, for example, because of pregnancy, separation, not dating
anyone, illness, or other reasons. I'd like to know the months

FIRST SEX]/ January, 1998) that you did not have intercourse at
all for the entire month. First, let's make sure you have other
information on your calendar.

times when you were not having intercourse at all for one month or
more?
